workstream: C18 — Stroke gold scaling + canonical L1/L2/L3 taxonomy bench wiring

built.canonicalTaxonomy: Verified ml/README.md points to packages/shared-types/src/pickleballTaxonomy.ts as product-wide source of truth; its existing contract contains 61 unique techniques across 9 families.
built.bench: Added a versioned pickleball-taxonomy-v2 gold contract and swing-lab scoring for L1 family, L2 side, and L3 exact technique. Verdicts preserve correct, wrong, abstained, ambiguous, gold_unknown, and L2 not_applicable separately. Reports include per-level confusion matrices.
built.declaredIntentPrior: Added an opt-in prior that may deepen a sub-L3 abstention only when compatible with observed side. AUTO/null is inert; contradictory observed side or an existing L3 observation is never overwritten. The comparison path is fixture-tested with and without the prior.
built.linuxBehavior: The CLI reads committed stroke gold and looks only for canonical report.json outputs. With run directories absent, it reports prediction-side metrics unavailable and identifies the macOS pose extraction / pnpm lab:regen dependency rather than producing numbers.
